limitations: The current local COMP.FUNDA vintage is later than the 1997 source files; historical source-vintage coverage cannot be inferred from the paper’s research-file description.

The source does not identify the baseline estimator, standard-error calculation, residual-generating regression, pooling of EARN/CF percentile cutoffs, denominator timing for CF(t+1), or exact share-price mnemonic. Pooled OLS with conventional unclustered errors, pooled cutoffs, an Equation (11) k=2 residual screen, own-period lead deflation, and annual PRCC_F with primary-IID currency verification are documented best-effort choices.

Absolute dollar screens use annual EXRAT12M for sales and the dated primary-IID SEC_DPRC.CURCDD to verify the currency of annual PRCC_F, translated using daily EXRATD at the matched fiscal-close quote date and the provider-documented GBP cross-rate formula. Non-identity foreign-currency conversions require positive, known, unique FX quote legs on a common date; GBP uses one observed GBP-to-USD quote with an identity source leg, and USD uses direct identity without an observed FX quote. EXRATTPD is retained per leg as quote provenance and is not an exclusion rule. A missing or ambiguous observed route leaves the USD quantity unavailable.

A bounded source audit found FUNDA.IID differs from the dated unique SEC_MTH primary IID in 647 of 10,500 final rows. The local catalog labels FUNDA.IID as Header Primary Global Issue ID; the current issue-level SEC_MTHPRC data support the dated primary-IID route: CURCDD and CURCDM agree on all 10,496 final rows with monthly quotes, and annual PRCC_F is within $0.005 of the same-date primary-IID PRCCM on 10,495 of those rows. One price value differs by $1.375 with currencies still agreeing; four rows lack a monthly quote but have a known dated daily-price currency/FX route. These price comparisons are diagnostic only; no price-equality screen is imposed.

Cross-year monetary differences and average-assets denominators remain unavailable when adjacent fiscal-year CURCD codes are missing or differ; no unreported translation is imposed on the ratio construction.

The paper does not specify how missing Compustat #124/XIDOC should be treated. CF is unavailable when OANCF or XIDOC is missing. The local guide’s Combined Figure note does not establish that all missing XIDOC values are structural zero; a bounded audit found 384 such cases among 113,560 OANCF-observed rows, and the final build reports sample-window counts and attrition.

The exact #103 depreciation item remains XDP as specified by the paper. The provider guide documents collection stopping in January 1997, but the cause of each missing local XDP value is unknown; no generic zero imputation or replacement with DP/DPC is made.
